a: INAF-TAC allocates about 1000 hours of queue observations on REM. REM is a robotic 60-cm telescope at ESO La Silla that images simultaneously in optical (g, r, i, z) and near-IR.
dt: AOT55 (2027A) deadline Monday Nov 23, 2026, 12:00 UT, for observations Apr 1 to Sep 30, 2027.
e: INAF's semester call covers both the TNG and REM telescopes. TNG time is limited to Italian-led proposals (or HARPS-N Collaboration members for exoplanet work), but the nationality restriction does not apply to REM proposals.
n: INAF TNG/REM Call for Proposals (REM 60-cm robotic telescope at La Silla)
